scripts.title: all floppas open source
scripts.features: just teleport to all floppas (in your map)
scripts.script:
local floppasFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Floppas")
if not floppasFolder then return end
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local function teleportTo(target)
    if target:IsA("BasePart") then
        hrp.CFrame = target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        wait(0.5)
    end
end
for _, obj in ipairs(floppasFolder:GetChildren()) do
    teleportTo(obj)
end
